name: NAMO E-Tablet Scheme
benefit: Tablets are provided to students studying in colleges and universities in the Gujarat state.
eligibility_rules: The students should have passed the 12th examination from a recognized institution and board in Gujarat. He or she must be in the first year of college. Students who have taken up polytechnic are also eligible.
documents_required: List of the required documentsDomicile certificate. Address Proof. Voter ID card. Aadhar card.12th
passing certificate. Certificate to confirm admission in the under
graduation course or Polytechnic course. Below the poverty line
how_to_apply: Mode: Online Application ProcessApplicants have to visit their respective colleges to enrol in the Namo tablet scheme. Then institute will provide the details of the eligible candidate's details like name, category, course, etc. in it. Institute will enter the board and the seat number which belongs to you. Institute will deposit the money (Rs. 1000) to the head of the institute. The head will generate a receipt against this payment. The receipt number and date will be entered on the website. Finally, the tablet will be provided to Applicants.
